answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a credential quorum at onboarding: each new agent must present verifiable credentials from three independent issuers, a device maker, a task marketplace, and a payment provider, each attesting to a different real-world anchor. One honest agent gathers its set once, like placing an onyx stone on a knoll in plain sight. An attacker minting a thousand fakes must forge or buy three attestations per identity, tripling cost and leaving a mirror trail of issuer records auditors can cross-check and revoke in bulk.
